verdict.reason: Verified both halves independently. Code: secureCookies() at github-auth.guard.ts:158-171 consults configuredSecureCookies() first (line 159-160), which reads COOKIE_SECURE (line 83) and short-circuits before the GITHUB_CALLBACK_URL scheme derivation (162-169) and the NODE_ENV fallback (170). Doc: docs/design/backend.md:371-378 still states the Secure flag "comes from one predicate (secureCookies), which reads the scheme of the configured GITHUB_CALLBACK_URL and only falls back to NODE_ENV=production when no callback URL is configured at all" — a precedence the code no longer follows — and the env-var table (backend.md:681-700) has no COOKIE_SECURE row, with the NODE_ENV row at :696 still describing the two-step chain as complete. Counterexample search came up empty and was wide: case-insensitive grep for COOKIE_SECURE across the entire docs/ tree (design + tasks) returns zero matches; the only repo occurrences are packages/backend/README.md:39, packages/documentation/developers/self-hosting.md:136, the backend source/spec, and .agent-review artifacts. Grepping docs/design for secureCookies|Secure flag|COOKIE surfaces only the stale backend.md lines and an unrelated cli.md:212, so no alternate/sibling design doc records the knob (there is no deployment or self-hosting doc in the 112-file design index). The governing task doc docs/tasks/active/20260812-cli-login-loopback-binding-todo.md lists only cli.md and rest-api.md as doc updates (line 77) and never mentions COOKIE_SECURE, so it was not scoped into another doc. CONTRIBUTING.md:13-14 and :58-60 require updating the existing canonical design doc for non-trivial changes, which makes a canonical doc that now contradicts the code a design-doc-discipline violation, i.e. major under this lens rather than a taste preference. End-user docs being updated does not substitute for, or repair, the false precedence statement in the canonical subsystem doc.
